sources.ref: feat/sprite-inventory@f1baabe (tip of PR #3 docs/ben-evolution; stack is #1 docs/ben-character-sheet, #2 feat/ben-g-typescript, #3 docs/ben-evolution on main@a43b322)

slots.label: Stand, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) returns `Spr::BenStand` at rest (l.1469); the sprite faces right and render.rs flips it for left (l.1247 `flip: p.face < 0.0`).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` (l.895) plays Fizz 1's `ben_*` grids from assets/sprites/fizz1-slice.json; on trial/lab-ben-sprites `lab_standRight` (l.932, ep2-ben-lab.json) replaces it. benA_idle in ep2-ben-a.json is data only (docs/SPRITES.md l.66: "no code reads the `benA_` sprites yet").

old.note: Fizz 2 data also has benA_idle (24x32, ep2-ben-a), unplayed.

slots.notes: Lab art is wired only on the unmerged Fizz 2 trial branch (cropped to lab_standRight, 14x33). Carries the Stunner on the right hip as the character sheet requires.

slots.label: Stand, facing left

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) `Spr::BenStand` flipped by `face` (render.rs l.1247); no left-specific art.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` returns `lab_standLeft` when `ben.face < 0.0` (l.930) on trial/lab-ben-sprites; main flips Fizz 1's stand.

old.note: A mirror of the right-facing sprite; Fizz 1 has no separate left art.

slots.notes: `ben_stand` is the left-facing stand. It has no visible Stunner pixels, which is correct: the Stunner rides on the right hip, which is the far hip when he faces left (a mirrored right-facing copy would wrongly show it on the near hip).

slots.label: Stand, facing the camera

fizz1.evidence: No code in episodes/episode-1 draws a front-facing Ben (ben_sprite l.1424 has only side-view poses).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` never returns a front stand; `lab_standRight`/`lab_standLeft` are the only stands. No lab_front sprite exists in ep2-ben-lab.json.

slots.notes: README.md says "The game currently has no dedicated front-facing stand; these poses are lab assets." It is the base of the look-up and look-down frames.

slots.label: Standing turn-around, 24 angles

fizz1.evidence: No turn or rotate-in-place state in Fizz 1 (world.rs `Player` has `face` as -1 or 1 only, l.222).

fizz2.evidence: docs/SPRITES.md l.78: "Fizz 1 has no turn or idle animation"; crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs `face` is -1 or 1.

slots.notes: Rendered from the 3D model through the sprite converter (PR #10 on main) and listed in docs/TURNTABLE_REVIEW.md as needing redrawn in-betweens; only the front and quarter keys are hand-drawn. Uncertain which of the 24 angles have been fully redrawn since.

slots.label: Run, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `Spr::BenRun1`/`BenRun2` while `|vx| > 0.5` (l.1459-1462); title and cutscenes also play `ben_run1`/`ben_run2` (episodes/episode-1/src/cine.ts l.247, l.297).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` plays `LAB_RUN` lab_run1..6 on trial/lab-ben-sprites (l.913-918); main plays `ben_run1`/`ben_run2`.

old.note: Fizz 2 data also has benA_run1..4 (24x32, ep2-ben-a), unplayed.

slots.notes: Fizz 2 trial branch imports ben_walkRight1..6 (the earlier six-frame run), not today's walk-run-6 cut of the odd frames of the twelve-frame run; re-import before relying on it. The twelve-frame `walk-run` animation (ben_walkRight1..12) is 6336 bytes at 4 bits.

slots.label: Run, facing left

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) flips the run frames for `face < 0` (render.rs l.1247); no left art.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` plays `LAB_RUN_LEFT` lab_runL1..6 when `ben.face < 0.0` (l.915-916) on trial/lab-ben-sprites.

slots.notes: Left-facing frames are drawn, not mirrored: the Stunner is on the hidden far hip, so they show no Stunner pixels. Same six-frame caveat as run-right.

slots.label: Jump, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `Spr::BenJump` whenever Ben is airborne and not firing (l.1456-1457).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` returns `ben_jump` when `!ben.b.on_ground` (l.909-910), Fizz 1's sprite.

old.note: Fizz 2 data also has benA_jump (24x32, ep2-ben-a), unplayed.

slots.notes: The game plays one frame for the whole air time; the lab loop (crouch, take-off, stride, landing) is a six-frame animation whose phases would need mapping to rise/apex/fall. The older single study `ben_jump` (24x44) also remains in assets.json.

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) `Spr::BenJump` flipped by `face`.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` `ben_jump` flipped by `ben.face` (draw_ben l.957).

slots.label: Fall, facing right

fizz1.evidence: No separate fall pose: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) shows `BenJump` for any airborne frame (l.1456), including a fall; the camera has a long-fall case (tests.rs `the_tower_camera_keeps_ben_in_view_through_a_long_fall`).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` has no fall branch (airborne is `ben_jump`, l.909); ep2-ben-a.json holds an unplayed `benA_fall`.

old.note: Fizz 2 provisional art, not played by any code.

slots.notes: Needs a rule (vy below a threshold) in the game view to choose it; neither game has one.

fizz1.evidence: As fall-right: render.rs l.1456 shows BenJump flipped.

fizz2.evidence: As fall-right: no fall branch in `ben_pose`.

slots.label: Land after a jump or fall

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/world.rs `Body.on_ground` flips on landing (test `ben_lands_and_stands_on_the_ground`, tests.rs l.37) but no landing pose exists; pogo has `squash` (world.rs `Player.squash`) only.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs has `squash` for the pogo only (l.102); no landing timer.

slots.notes: The lab jump loop begins with a crouch (ben_jumpRig1, 180 ms) and the character sheet says the model "absorbs into the knees", but no frame is saved as a dedicated landing. Not verified whether jumpRig1 can double as one.

slots.label: Crouch or duck

fizz1.evidence: No crouch or duck state in Fizz 1 (searched world.rs, render.rs and GAME_DESIGN.md).

fizz2.evidence: No crouch in fizz-ep2 (ben.rs) or docs/PLATFORM.md.

slots.notes: Listed for completeness only: neither game has the mechanic, so it is not a gap. The jump loop's crouch is anticipation, not a held pose.

slots.label: Climb a ladder or vine (from behind)

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `Spr::BenClimb1`/`BenClimb2` while `p.climb` (l.1444-1449); vines set `climb` too (world.rs l.1786 `self.p.climb = true`); intro cutscene climbs down with them (cine.ts l.293).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs header l.8: "Left out on purpose: mantle, ladders and vines, wall kicks"; docs/PLATFORM.md l.164.

slots.notes: The lab ladder frames (32x48) are drawn from behind with the Stunner on the right hip. Legacy 24x44 studies ben_climb1/ben_climb2 are still in assets.json. Firing up or down on a ladder uses the aim poses instead.

slots.label: Ledge grab, pull and mantle, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `BenMantle1` grip, `BenMantle2` haul, `BenMantle3` push by `m.progress()` (l.1428-1436); docs/GAME_DESIGN.md "Mantle" describes the three frames.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs l.83-86 "Mantle is out of scope"; docs/PLATFORM.md l.164.

slots.notes: Fizz 1 plays three poses across 0.30 s (MANTLE_TIME, world.rs l.70); the lab pull is eleven frames (about 1.0 s). Mapping to grab/haul/push is a decision for whoever wires it, and the timing differs by more than three times.

slots.label: Ledge grab, pull and mantle, facing left

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) mantle poses flipped by `face`.

fizz2.evidence: As mantle-right: mantle is not in Fizz 2.

slots.label: Wall-kick off a wall

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/world.rs `WALL_KICK_UP`/`WALL_KICK_AWAY` (l.76-77) and docs/GAME_DESIGN.md "Wall-kick" define the action, but ben_sprite l.1424 has no kick branch, so a kick shows `BenJump`.

fizz2.evidence: docs/FIZZ1-DIFFERENCES.md "Wall-kick: left out" (owner decision 2026-10-30).

slots.notes: Only Fizz 1 needs it, and it currently reuses the jump frame.

slots.label: Pogo ride, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `BenPogo2` during the squash, `BenPogo` otherwise (l.1437-1441); title screen also plays `pogo`/`pogo2` (packages/engine/src/menu/title-ben.ts l.7).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pogo2`/`ben_pogo` (l.897-902) from Fizz 1's grids; `benA_pogoUp`/`benA_pogoDown` exist unplayed in ep2-ben-a.json.

old.note: Squash frame is `ben_pogo2`. Fizz 2 data also has benA_pogoUp and benA_pogoDown (24x40).

slots.notes: Twelve frames over 840 ms redrawn from the 3D pogo stick (PR #16 on main). The games need a mapping from squash/rise/apex to frames; they show two poses today.

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) pogo poses flipped by `face`.

fizz2.evidence: As pogo-right, flipped by `ben.face`.

slots.label: Fire the Stunner sideways, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `BenShoot` while `shoot_t > 0` and aim level (l.1450-1454).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `LAB_FIRE` lab_fire1..6 spread over `SHOOT_POSE` by `lab_fire_frame` (l.888, l.908) on trial/lab-ben-sprites; main plays `ben_shoot`.

old.note: Fizz 2 data also has benA_shoot, unplayed.

slots.notes: Six frames over 600 ms; Fizz 2 stretches them across its 0.25 s `SHOOT_POSE` (ben.rs l.32) in proportion.

slots.label: Fire the Stunner sideways, facing left

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) `BenShoot` flipped by `face`.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs draw_ben l.957: lab_fire frames are flipped for `face < 0`, which moves the Stunner to the wrong hip.

slots.notes: No ben_fireLeft frames exist. A mirrored right-facing fire frame puts the Stunner in the left hand on the near side; a true left-facing fire would hold it with the right hand across the body or show it from behind. Needs designing, not just drawing.

slots.label: Recoil after a shot

fizz1.evidence: Fizz 1 has one shoot sprite and no recoil frame (ben_sprite l.1450-1454).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs has no recoil frame; the fire frames already carry recoil.

slots.notes: Legacy 24x44 study from before the rig redraw; superseded by ben_fireRight4..6.

slots.label: Fire upward

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `BenAimUp` when `p.aim == 1` (l.1452).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_aimUp` (l.906); asserted by tests at l.1568 and l.1884.

slots.notes: The lab only has the legacy 24x44 study; it predates the rig redraw and the Stunner design, so check its helmet, shoes and gun before use. No left-facing variant.

slots.label: Fire downward

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `BenAimDown` when `p.aim == -1` (l.1453).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_aimDown` (l.907).

slots.notes: Same caveat as aim-up.

slots.label: Reload the Stunner

fizz1.evidence: Fizz 1 counts shots (Fizz Blaster ammo is not refilled on death, per docs/GAME_DESIGN.md) but has no reload action or pose.

fizz2.evidence: Fizz 2 restarts Ben with five shots (docs/FIZZ1-DIFFERENCES.md "Ammo on a respawn") and has a `dud` event (ben.rs l.78) but no reload pose.

slots.notes: Rendered from the 3D model by `draw:model-poses`; the character sheet says it waits on a loose can the skin has none of. Whether either game gets a reload action is undecided.

slots.label: Death

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `p.dead > 0.0` returns `BenJump`, turned by `rot` (l.1425-1426, draw l.1247-1248); Fizz 1 has no dedicated death pose.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` returns `ben_jump` for `dead` and `blit_sprite_turned` spins it (l.896-897, l.936); docs/SPRITES.md l.80.

old.note: A stand-in: the jump frame spun about its centre. Fizz 2 data also has benA_hurt, unplayed.

slots.notes: Lab death is a seven-beat comic sequence (40x56, about 1.4 s) with a topple that would replace the spin. The Fizz games fix a 1.4 s dead timer in world.rs l.1123, which fits.

slots.label: Hurt, non-fatal hit

fizz1.evidence: docs/GAME_DESIGN.md "Mantle": "any hit is fatal"; world.rs l.1594 kills unless `inv > 0`.

fizz2.evidence: ep2-ben-a.json holds `benA_hurt` (24x32) that no code plays; `Ben.inv` (ben.rs l.99) only blinks the sprite (draw_ben l.941), and contact kills (world.rs l.576).

slots.notes: Counts as a gap only if Fizz 2 adopts non-fatal damage; docs/SPRITES.md l.58 says Fizz 1 has no hurt or dead pose.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` returns `lab_lookUp` for `ben.look_up > 0.0` (l.920-921) on trial/lab-ben-sprites; main plays `ben_lookUp`.

slots.notes: The lab look frames face the camera (lab_lookUp is not flipped). A legacy side-view ben_lookUp study (24x44) is also in assets.json.

slots.notes: Two lab frames replace the single Fizz 1 pose. Legacy side-view ben_lookDown study is in assets.json.

slots.label: Draw the pogo stick from a pocket

fizz1.evidence: docs/GAME_DESIGN.md "Pogo": toggled on and off; ben_sprite l.1437 simply switches to the pogo pose with no draw action.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs `pogo` is a boolean toggle (l.91); no draw transition in crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs.
